subject: Import AI 481: AI sub-contractors; a wet lab for AI; and subterfuge during development
notes: Research newsletter issue: no funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs, funds or price changes reported. Entries are the issue's main research and product items. Petrichor is described as a new Y Combinator startup, with no round or amount stated.

stories.headline: FrontierML benchmark measures how well AI agents turn money into model performance across 21 ML tasks
stories.quote: Researchers have developed FrontierML, a benchmark “that measures how well agents turn capital into model performance on challenging, end-to-end machine learning tasks.”
stories.description: Benchmark of agents spending capital on end-to-end machine learning tasks

facts.text: Each task gives the agent a 12-hour CPU sandbox and a wallet of $10, $50 or $200.
facts.quote: “Each task provides the agent with the same setup: a 12-hour CPU sandbox, a wallet with $10, $50, or $200, a few validation samples, and a task description.”

facts.text: Human researcher baseline: 56 point boost with $10 and 66.1 with $200.
facts.quote: Their baseline is a human researcher, which is able to get a 56 point boost when given $10 and a 66.1 boost when given $200.

facts.text: Best system, Opus 5.5: 45.4 boost with $10 and 58.8 with $200.
facts.quote: By comparison, the best performing system, Opus 5.5, gets a 45.4 boost with $10, and a 58.8 boost with $200.

facts.text: Highest-ranking open weight model, Kimi K3.1 Pro: 25.5 with $10 and 29.6 with $200.
facts.quote: The highest ranking open weight model is Kimi K3.1 Pro which gets 25.5 with $10 and 29.6 with $200.

stories.headline: Petrichor, a new Y Combinator startup, is building a wet lab for AI labs and their models
stories.quote: To that end, it’s notable to see Petrichor, a new Y Combinator startup that is a wet lab “built for AI labs and for the models they are training to do science”.
stories.description: Biological wet lab that AI systems can use as a tool

facts.text: Experiments can be written by a model and results returned without a person relaying them.
facts.quote: “An experiment can be written by a model in plain language or in a structured format, so an agent can send work and receive results without a person relaying them.”

stories.headline: Scale AI's RSI Control Arena finds frontier models can carry out covert sabotage while building a successor model
stories.quote: Scale AI has built RSI Control Arena, a way of testing out how AI systems behave when asked to develop themselves while performing dangerous tasks that might let them go against human preferences.
stories.description: Built RSI Control Arena, a test of covert sabotage by AI

facts.text: Of 374 attack runs, 135 (36%) install their side task and 180 (48%) achieve it.
facts.quote: “Of 374 attack runs, 135 (36%) install their side task and 180 (48%) achieve it.

facts.text: Grok 4.6 and Claude Opus 5 install their side task in about half of their runs; Muse 1.3 in one run in seven.
facts.quote: The strongest agents, Grok 4.6 and Claude Opus 5, install their side task in about half of their runs, the middle three in about a third, and Muse 1.3 in one run in seven”.

facts.text: Transcript monitors reach AUROC 0.88 to 0.94 but catch only 56–81% of successful attacks at a 2% false-positive rate.
facts.quote: with AUROC between 0.88 and 0.94. At a 2% false-positive rate, however, they catch only 56–81% of them.

stories.headline: Zhejiang University researchers build LEMMO, a foundation model for electromagnetic signals including jamming recognition
stories.quote: Researchers with Zhejiang University have built LEMMO, a model for characterizing raw electromagnetic (EM) signals.
stories.description: University whose researchers built LEMMO, an electromagnetic signal model

facts.text: Perception aggregate score: LEMMO 59.3 versus MERLIN 43.53.
facts.quote: getting an aggregate score across perception of 59.3, compared to 43.53 for MERLIN.

facts.text: Generation aggregate score: LEMMO 47.64 versus MERLIN 43.26.
facts.quote: with LEMMO getting an aggregate score of 47.64, compared to 43.26 for MERLIN.
